comment: PS original (1996-12-27). Official count: 67 scenarios total (ja Wikipedia: 66 across Earth+Space routes, +1 final scenario in 3 segments after clearing both routes; Namu wiki likewise 67). Enumerated from M. Neidengard's GameFAQs walkthrough (Neoseeker mirror) cross-checked with J_Ong's buried-item FAQ (Both Routes 1-7, Space 8-35, Earth 8-35 with Earth 29 split into two maps 29-1/29-2) and Kurisu's Chronogaming playlog (space route stage-by-stage incl. victory conditions): 7 common + 28 space + earth 8-35 with stage 20 split into 20EA/20EB variants and stage 29 split into two maps = 66 route scenarios, built here as 65 route pages + final scenario = 66 detail pages. The remaining official route scenario is the third stage-20 variant (Kurisu: 'one instance where you can get one of three stages'; Neidengard documents only the counterattack / no-counterattack outcomes at stages 19-20) - documented as an unverified note on the 20EA/20EB pages instead of a fabricated page. NO published per-stage enemy placement/levels/coordinates exist for this title (Akurasu has only a Secrets page for Shin - no flow chart; GameCenter GX does not cover it), so enemies sections follow the SRW3/EX precedent. Victory/defeat conditions are stated only where Neidengard/Akurasu/Kurisu state them explicitly. Buried-item coordinates from J_Ong's FAQ (x,y from top-left; author's caveat: try +1 to both). Japanese original scenario titles are not published in accessible sources; the ja field carries Neidengard's romaji transcription.
